Pattern	Matches
**/*                            Skips all tests
com/example/MyClass.class       Skips target class
**/SomeTest 			        Any class named SomeTest in any package
com/example/*EndingWith		    Any class ending with Test in com.example package only
com/example/**/StartingWith*	Any class under com.example (any subpackage) starting with Slow
**/skipped/**			        Any class under any package folder named skipped


For pushing JavaDocs
    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v7
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: build/docs/javadoc
